notes: Chosen on validation MAE (random_forest 7.4626, lgbm 8.0099, naive 8.7778); TimeSeriesSplit(5) CV MAE on train: {'random_forest': 7.9978, 'lgbm': 9.9756}. Refit on train+val. Test metrics use true lags and the week's own weather (one-step-ahead); the 4-week forecast is recursive and uses last year's same-week weather, so real multi-week error is higher. improvement_over_naive is the fractional MAE reduction versus last week's count.
